candidate_status_definitions.provisional_fragile: Failed at least one current robustness gate; retained for diagnosis.
candidate_status_definitions.provisional_new_family: Leading configuration from a newly tested family; basic retrospective gates passed, deeper gates pending.
candidate_status_definitions.provisional_robust: Passed the currently implemented retrospective robustness gates; still not final.
candidate_status_definitions.provisional_robust_new_family: Passed Batch 05 retrospective gates; untouched validation still missing.
candidate_status_definitions.provisional_robust_research_only: Passed statistical gates but has a source-data limitation that blocks stronger use.
candidate_status_definitions.provisional_ggg_improvement: Improved the clean GGG benchmark in a retrospective screened blend; deeper robustness and untouched forward evidence remain required.
candidate_status_definitions.provisional_ggg_return_leader: Return-first GGG challenger that passed its retrospective improvement route but accepts higher historical drawdown and still lacks untouched evidence.
candidate_status_definitions.provisional_aggressive_return_ceiling: Highest unlevered recent-return point estimate retained for confirmation after failing a declared statistical breadth or multiplicity gate.
